title: BoostLoRA: Growing Effective Rank by Boosting Adapters
abstract: arXiv:2604.27308v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods face a tradeoff between adapter size and expressivity: ultra-low-parameter adapters are confined to fixed low-rank subspaces, capping performance even with extended training. We propose BoostLoRA, a gradient-boosting framework that overcomes this limit by iteratively training and merging minimal adapters on the examples the current model gets wrong. A ROTATE SVD basis strategy assigns each round to an orthogonal subspace, so cumulative effective rank grows linearly with the number of rounds while each adapter remains ultra-low-rank. After merging, adapters are discarded, leaving zero inference overhead. translated_title: BoostLoRA：通过Boosting适配器来增长有效秩
translated_abstract: 参数高效微调（PEFT）方法面临适配器大小与表达能力之间的权衡：超低参数适配器被限制在固定的低秩子空间中，即使延长训练时间也无法突破性能上限。我们提出BoostLoRA，一种梯度提升框架，通过在当前模型出错的样本上迭代训练并合并极小适配器来克服这一限制。ROTATE SVD基策略将每一轮分配到一个正交子空间，使累积有效秩随轮数线性增长，同时每个适配器仍保持超低秩。合并完成后，适配器即被丢弃，推理阶段零额外开销。在Qwen2.5-3B上，BoostLoRA在GSM8K上达到89.1%，在MATH-500上达到68.8%，超越了最佳的单次超低参数适配器方法（TinyLoRA）和全量微调；在代码生成方面，它在MBPP上达到57.2%，在HumanEval上达到80.4%，而全量微调则降至零样本基线之下。
tldr: BoostLoRA提出一种梯度提升框架，通过在错误样本上迭代训练并合并正交子空间的超低秩适配器，使有效秩随轮次线性增长，在不增加任何推理开销的情况下超越了全量微调的性能。
en_tdlr: BoostLoRA is a gradient-boosting framework that iteratively trains and merges ultra-low-rank adapters on orthogonal subspaces, growing effective rank linearly while surpassing full fine-tuning with zero inference overhead.
